construct: a DRAWN ::after decor box whose entire SHAPE is a clip-path (the antd tooltip arrow: a 16x8 solid box cut to a triangle)
why: The decor grammar promotes the box on background-color + border ring and never reads clip-path, so antd's tooltip arrow minted as its UNCLIPPED 16x8 rectangle — a flat-topped tab where the library draws a point. The loss was SILENT TWICE: the pseudo reader consumes the channel so it never reaches codeOnlyChannels, and no artifact in the naming union mentioned it. ShapeSchema is rect / ellipse / REGULAR n-gon, so the region has no contract spelling today; the honest outcome is a NAMED wall carrying the measured clip value, not a guessed polygon. Declared REFUSED, not UNSUPPORTED: the channel IS read (the decor reader consumes the pseudo's whole style map) and is now refused BY NAME beside the carriage - 'never modelled' would be the wrong fact about it.

canvas.note: the clip region has no frame-level spelling; the decor box is promoted unclipped and the clip is named as a wall beside it
